browser-tool-settings.title: Browser tool Settings UI — toggle + CDP-status + chrome flag CTA
browser-tool-settings.description:
Surface browser_script in AgentBehavior settings as a Tools section toggle. When ON, show status row (✓ Active or ✗ Chrome devtools not exposed) + CTA to open chrome://flags#enable-command-line-on-non-rooted-devices when not active. Auto-write /data/local/tmp/chrome-command-line via Shizuku on toggle ON (silent). Detect via shell `cat /proc/net/unix | grep chrome_devtools_remote`. Three CTA fallbacks: ACTION_VIEW intent → Shizuku am start → clipboard.

Does NOT touch onboarding flow. KISS — user manually toggles the chrome flag (one-time); ClosePaw just makes that easy to find. Full design at projects/active/browser_setting/design.md.
acceptCriteria: New Tools section in AgentBehavior settings page
browser_script toggle wired to persisted user pref (default OFF)
Toggle ON: status row appears within 500ms
Status ✓ when /proc/net/unix contains @chrome_devtools_remote, ✗ otherwise
Status ✗: CTA button opens chrome://flags via Intent → Shizuku am start → clipboard fallback chain
Re-check button re-detects without page reload
Toggle ON auto-writes /data/local/tmp/chrome-command-line via Shizuku (silent, idempotent)
Toggle OFF removes browser_script from agent tool allowlist
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lint passes
UI screenshots for 3 states (off / on + ✓ / on + ✗ + CTA)
browser-tool-settings.note: 3 commits: e563b6a5 + 53514ef8 + 2dbbeff1. Codex caught 9 issues across 3 review rounds, all fixed. Final R4 review found one debug-only bypass (MainActivityIntentApplier.kt:98) — accepted as debug-only QA path. browser-pair-once-cache.title: Pair-once cache for locked-OEM cold sessions
browser-pair-once-cache.description: On locked OEMs (e.g. nubia P0110) /data/misc/adb/adb_keys is unreadable for the Shizuku UserService UID, so AdbWirelessManager.isPubkeyAuthorized() returns false (ChromeDevtoolsUserService.kt:121-128 reads null → AdbWirelessManager.kt:62-65 → false), and WirelessAdbSelfPairTransport.kt:143-155 re-pairs every cold session. Add an app-side cache (DataStore preference) of the local pubkey fingerprint after the first successful pair so subsequent cold sessions can skip the spake2 pairing roundtrip even when adb_keys is unreadable. Cache invalidated on pubkey rotation.
acceptCriteria: PairOnceCache persists local pubkey fingerprint after first successful pair
WirelessAdbSelfPairTransport short-circuits to TLS connect when cache hit and adb_keys is unreadable
Cache invalidated when local pubkey changes (rotation)
test -f app/src/test/kotlin/ai/closepaw/browser/cdp/wireless/PairOnceCacheTest.kt
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.closepaw.browser.cdp.wireless.PairOnceCacheTest"
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:lint passes
browser-pair-once-cache.note: committed 6e8e0e8d + fix-up 46a2999d (CRITICAL ordering + HIGH EACCES distinction). Codex re-review APPROVE. Cache active in production via WirelessAdbSelfPairTransport ctor, but BrowserSessionManager call site still passes null — wiring deferred to browser-pair-once-wiring task (depends on browser-dialog-tracking).

browser-tool-settings-debug-intent-gate.title: Decide: gate browser_script via MainActivityIntentApplier debug intent
browser-tool-settings-debug-intent-gate.description:
Codex round-4 review of browser-tool-settings noted that MainActivityIntentApplier.kt:98 accepts browserScriptEnabled=true from `adb shell am start --ez BROWSER_SCRIPT_ENABLED true ...` and calls settingsState.updateBrowserScriptEnabled(enabled) directly, bypassing the BrowserScriptToggleGate that both UI toggles now use. Impact: a QA script can persist browser_script=true with no Shizuku — toggle shows ON but tool will not work.

Decision needed: (a) route the debug intent through the gate (clean but harms QA workflows that pre-configure via adb), (b) leave as-is and document (current state — release builds no-op anyway), (c) add a separate test-only escape hatch (over-engineering).

Punted because debug-only path with no security impact.
acceptCriteria: Decision documented in this tasks.json note OR implemented
If gated: ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest passes
If documented: clear comment in MainActivityIntentApplier.kt explaining the bypass intent
browser-tool-settings-debug-intent-gate.note: Commit ba0a9b7d — applyIntentPayloadToSettings now takes browserScriptGate (default = production gate). ON goes through gate (skips persist if Shizuku unavailable); OFF stays unconditional; release builds still no-op via early return. Three new tests.

browser-cdp-probe-shizuku-fallback-bug.title: ChromeCdpProbe Shizuku fallback fails on nubia P0110
browser-cdp-probe-shizuku-fallback-bug.description: Nubia QA found ChromeCdpProbe returns Unknown despite the @chrome_devtools_remote socket being bound. The app-uid /proc/net/unix read fails (SELinux on this OEM, expected) and the Shizuku-backed `cat /proc/net/unix` fallback also fails for some reason — needs investigation. CTA path still works so the user is not blocked, but the Tools section status row never flips to ✓ Active even after a fully-correct config. Reduces user confidence that the feature is on. Investigate the Shizuku exec failure mode (logcat around ChromeCdpProbe.probe()), then either fix the Shizuku path or document the limitation in the status row copy.
acceptCriteria: Status row shows ✓ Active on nubia P0110 when Chrome is configured + running with --remote-debugging-socket-name=chrome_devtools_remote, OR clear documented limitation in status copy explaining why

browser-shellrunner-deadlock.title: ShizukuShellRunner pipe deadlock for large stdout
browser-shellrunner-deadlock.description: Codex review of commit 05b6c95e flagged: ShizukuShellRunner waits for process exit BEFORE draining stdout, so any command emitting more than the pipe buffer (~64KB) deadlocks until the 5s timeout. ChromeCdpProbe worked around this by using grep -F instead of cat, but future ShellRunner callers will repeat the failure mode silently. Fix: drain stdout in parallel with the exit poll (background reader thread or ProcessBuilder.redirectOutput to a temp file). Until fixed, add a TODO/warning in ShizukuShellRunner that calls must keep stdout small.
acceptCriteria: ShizukuShellRunner can return >100KB of stdout without deadlocking (test with: cat /proc/net/unix or similar)
Existing ShellRunner callers (ChromeCdpProbe via grep, CommandLineWriter, etc.) still work
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lint passes
browser-shellrunner-deadlock.note: Commit a14e539a — reader threads drain stdout/stderr in parallel with waitFor. ShellRunnerTest covers 100k-line seq (~588 KiB) regression + parallel stderr flood. ChromeCdpProbe still uses grep (the workaround stays for efficiency).

browser-shizuku-permission-request.title: Gate: request Shizuku permission inline when binder OK but UID grant stale
browser-shizuku-permission-request.description:
Investigation w-investigate-shizuku-gate found root cause for nubia user-blocking issue: after `adb install -r`, package gets a fresh UID (10322 → 10326). Shizuku tracks per-package consent by UID in /data/local/tmp/shizuku/shizuku.json. Shizuku Manager UI matches by package name and shows ✓ granted, but Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() in ClosePaw process queries by UID and returns DENIED. Gate falls into ShizukuNeedsPermission branch.

Fix: when gateBrowserScriptEnable() detects pingBinder() succeeds + checkSelfPermission() == DENIED, call Shizuku.requestPermission(reqCode) (already exposed at ShizukuRuntimeGateway.kt:33-35) which triggers Shizuku consent dialog. Wire OnRequestPermissionResultListener back so the gate retries after the user grants. Improve error copy to say re-grant rather than grant.
acceptCriteria: When pingBinder() succeeds AND checkSelfPermission() returns DENIED, gate calls Shizuku.requestPermission(reqCode) instead of failing immediately
After user grants in Shizuku consent dialog, gate retries and (if write succeeds) persists pref=true
If user denies the consent dialog, gate surfaces a clear error and pref stays OFF
Inline error copy distinguishes never-granted vs stale-grant
Unit test covers: PERMISSION_DENIED + binder OK → requestPermission called; grant result → retry path; deny result → ShizukuNeedsPermission
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lint passes
Manual verify on nubia P0110 (100.64.43.95:5555): tap toggle ON → Shizuku consent dialog appears → tap grant → toggle persists ON without needing to manually re-toggle in Shizuku Manager
browser-shizuku-permission-request.note: Verified live on nubia. UID-mismatch reproduced; consent dialog appears; grant persists across cold start. 12/12 unit tests pass. Compose plumbing turned out unneeded — Shizuku.requestPermission is a static API per worker analysis + existing DisplayModeSection precedent.
